variants.description: Section 01; title reads Cover Letter & Executive Summary.
Section 05; title reads Pricing & Assumptions; its hand-drawn underline is narrower.
Section 06; title reads Closing, its hand-drawn underline is narrower, and it includes an italic closing subtitle.

proposed_groups.rationale: All five previews share the left navy panel, right dotted white field, central magenta/blue abstract photo, large white section number, and recurring footer. Section number/title copy varies; 59 and 63 have narrower underlines, and 63 adds a subtitle.

variants.description: Four-level rating headers Extreme High, High, Average, Low; bullet placeholder row appears in High, Average, and Low.
Title, High, Average, Low headers; first body column shaded pale blue and bullet placeholder row appears in High, Average, and Low. Lower border and first-column fill remain source-specific.

proposed_groups.rationale: Both use the same broad four-column horizontally ruled table construction and share the High/Average/Low columns, while first-column role, styling, and content differ materially.

variants.description: Title, right-side Deliverables panel and bullet copy, activity rows, and schedule bars are visible.
The same title, Deliverables panel and bullet copy, activity rows, and schedule bars are visible; activity-row fills and grid treatment differ.

proposed_groups.rationale: Both show the title, June–August weekly schedule, Research/Design/Build bands, matching activity labels and colored bars, and right-side Deliverables panel with bullet copy. The activity-row fills and grid treatment differ visibly.

variants.description: Blue palette; all five rows are populated from Level one through Level five.
Gray palette; all five rows are populated from Level one through Level five.

proposed_groups.rationale: Both use a three-column multilevel table with two Description columns and all five numbered Level rows populated. The palette differs.
